name: memory-panel
title: Memory panel
author: Eduardo Retana
description: What the assistant keeps across chats. A switch turns memory off without deleting it. Each memory can be edited, paused, or forgotten.

meta.descriptionEs: Lo que el asistente guarda entre chats. El interruptor lo apaga sin borrar. Cada recuerdo se edita, se pausa o se olvida.

examples.title: Mariana y el horno
examples.description: Cuatro recuerdos del taller. Olvidar el correo a Celaya se puede deshacer.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Vacío, textos largos, RTL y diez recuerdos.

meta.usage: <MemoryPanel memories={memories} enabled={enabled} onEnabledChange={setEnabled} onEdit={edit} onPause={pause} onForget={forget} onRestore={restore} onAdd={add} />

api.name: memories
api.description: id, text, category, source, date, paused. meta is opaque. Source and date are shown as given.

api.name: enabled / onEnabledChange
api.description: The Use memory switch. Off does not delete the list.

api.name: onEdit / onPause / onForget / onRestore / onAdd
api.description: The host owns the list. Undo is whatever the host passes in undo; the piece does not run a clock.

api.name: undo
api.description: The forgotten line, with an Undo button, until the host clears it.

api.name: categories
api.description: Group order and the choices for a new memory.

api.name: loading / error / labels
api.description: Skeleton, alert, and chrome copy. English is the default.

docs: Inspirado en el comportamiento público de Affect; reimplementación clean-room; no código, datos, iconos ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. No es la ventana de este chat: es lo que queda para el siguiente.
